name: Reverse
description: Glitch²-style Reverse for NTS-3. Continuously captures AUDIO IN (get_raw_input on firmware 1.4+) and freezes a tempo slice on touch, playing it in ping-pong reverse/forward. Y = slice length (bottom long, top short). Depth = wet. Untouched = bypass. SYNC: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE. HOLD: GATE or LATCH.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the effect is engaged

params.name: SYNC
params.detail: Time grid: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to engage. LATCH = stays after release; switch back to GATE to stop
